confirm_payment_intent.description: Complete a payment by confirming it with a payment method.
confirm_payment_intent.name: confirm_payment_intent

parameters.description: The ID of the Stripe payment to confirm.
parameters.name: payment_intent_id

parameters.description: The ID of the payment method to charge, for example pm_card_visa in test mode.
parameters.name: payment_method

returns.description: Stripe payment intent object with status updated to 'succeeded'.

create_customer.name: create_customer

parameters.description: Customer email
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Customer name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Customer description
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Customer phone number
parameters.name: phone

returns.description: Stripe customer object returned by the Stripe API containing customer details.

create_payment_intent.description: Set up a payment to charge a customer a custom amount.
create_payment_intent.name: create_payment_intent

parameters.description: The amount to charge, in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (500 means $5.00).
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: The three-letter currency code, for example usd.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The ID of a customer to link this payment to (optional).
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: A short note describing what the payment is for.
parameters.name: description

returns.description: Stripe payment intent object returned by the Stripe API containing payment details.

create_payment_link.description: Generate a payment link for a price.
create_payment_link.name: create_payment_link

parameters.description: Stripe price ID
parameters.name: price_id

parameters.description: Quantity to purchase
parameters.name: quantity

returns.description: Stripe payment link object returned by the Stripe API containing the generated link URL.

create_price.description: Create a one-time or recurring price for a product.
create_price.name: create_price

parameters.description: Stripe product ID
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The price in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (500 means $5.00).
parameters.name: unit_amount

parameters.description: The three-letter currency code, for example usd.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: How often the customer is billed: day, week, month, or year.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: The number of billing intervals between charges. For example, 3 with a monthly interval charges every 3 months.
parameters.name: interval_count

returns.description: Stripe price object returned by the Stripe API containing pricing details.

create_product.description: Create a product to sell with Stripe.
create_product.name: create_product

parameters.description: Product name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Product description
parameters.name: description

returns.description: Stripe product object returned by the Stripe API containing product details.

list_customers.description: List your most recent Stripe customers.
list_customers.name: list_customers

parameters.description: Maximum customers to return
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Array of Stripe customer objects returned by the Stripe API.

items.description: Stripe customer object with customer details from the Stripe API.

refund_payment.description: Refund a payment, in full or in part.
refund_payment.name: refund_payment

parameters.description: The ID of the Stripe payment to refund.
parameters.name: payment_intent_id

parameters.description: The amount to refund, in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (200 means $2.00). Leave blank to refund the full payment.
parameters.name: amount

returns.description: Stripe refund object returned by the Stripe API containing refund details.

retrieve_customer.description: Look up a Stripe customer by their ID.

parameters.description: Stripe customer ID
